thread:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: High error rate on gen-queue (us-west). paging @alex_p :rotating_light:
alex_p: I'm on it. pulling logs now.
alex_p: quick check — tail of genqueue logs shows repeated OOMs from worker-7, restarting worker.
oncall-bot: On-call handoff: alex_p (current) → emily_sre (30m) — adding emily_sre for routing/scale
emily_sre: joining. can you drop the initial status page snippet here? i'll sign-off once we have mitigation
maria_ops: FYI product/customer comms — recommend we call out affected customers and ETA window in the notice
alex_p: draft for status page initial (please edit):
```
We are currently investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests in the US-West region. Some requests may return errors or experience increased latency. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on a mitigation. Impact: a subset of gen requests in US-West may fail. Mitigation: services being restarted and routing adjusted. Next update: in 30 minutes.
```
maria_ops: change "some requests" -> "some customer requests", and add severity line
alex_p: updated snippet:
```
We are currently investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests in the US-West region.
Severity: Partial service degradation (some customers affected).
Impact: Some customer requests may return errors or experience increased latency. Engineers are investigating; we are restarting affected workers and adjusting routing.
Next update: in 30 minutes.
```
legal_jd: please don't include "some customers affected" phrasing without scope. replace with "a subset of customers" and avoid concrete timelines as commitments
maria_ops: ok change timeline to "approximate" and add contact line
alex_p: revised draft:
```
We are currently investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests in the US-West region.
Severity: Partial service degradation (a subset of customers may be impacted).
Impact: A subset of customer requests may return errors or experience increased latency. Engineers are investigating and have restarted affected workers and are routing around the issue.
Approximate next update: ~30 minutes.
How to contact support: customers can reach support via the Console or support@redwood.ai
```
emily_sre: system metrics show error rate trending down after the restart (errors from 6% -> 1.2% over 10m). i'll post an ops update once rate <1%
alex_p: nice. can we add an internal note line for customers using Dedicated clusters? (they might have different routing)
maria_ops: add line: "If you're on Dedicated, contact SE" ? maybe better: "Dedicated customers may observe different behavior; contact your SE."
alex_p: final publish-ready initial posted above with those edits. tagging oncall for approval: @emily_sre
emily_sre: approved to publish initial. small wording tweak: replace support email domain with support@redwoodinference.com
alex_p: publishing now.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE POSTED (initial) — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/incident-1766123456 :white_check_mark:
alex_p: follow-up: applied temporary routing to bypass worker-7. continuing to monitor.
emily_sre: update for status page (30m): errors down to 0.9%, will publish progress update + note about mitigation being rolled back if stable.
maria_ops: draft update text:
```
Update: We applied a temporary routing change which has reduced error rates. Error rate decreased from ~6% to ~1% over the last 10 minutes. We will continue to monitor and may roll back the temporary routing once stability is confirmed.
```
emily_sre: approved.
alex_p: publishing update.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATED (progress) — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/incident-1766123456
alex_p: final verification — metrics steady at 0.7% for 20m. i'll start rolling back routing now, will watch for spike.
emily_sre: if rollback holds for 15m, we can resolve.
alex_p: rollback complete, metrics stable.
maria_ops: draft resolved post:
```
Resolved: The elevated error rate affecting text generation requests in US-West has been mitigated. Root cause: OOM on a worker that caused cascading errors; temporary routing and worker restart restored service.
Impact: A subset of customers in US-West may have seen errors between 14:02 - 14:42 UTC. If you still experience issues, contact support.
```
legal_jd: ok with that wording, please avoid detailed internals beyond the RCA note. add "Post-incident: RCA forthcoming" if we plan to publish one
maria_ops: added line.
alex_p: publishing resolved.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATED (resolved) — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/incident-1766123456 :tada:
oncall-bot: On-call handoff: emily_sre → next oncall in 30m
maria_ops: closing comms thread. will coordinate RCA doc with SRE; tagging @legal_jd for review before external RCA
alex_p: thanks all. :thumbsup:
